bill.title: A Resolution urging the Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission to evaluate and approve the addition of the American Paddlefish to the Species by Watershed Approved for Open System Propagation and Introductions list.

posted_text:
💧 PA SR 409 — Pa. Senate Wants Paddlefish Added to State Waters

The Pennsylvania State Senate is asking the Fish and Boat Commission to consider adding the American Paddlefish to a list of species approved for open-system propagation and introductions.

The resolution argues that this paddlefish, once common in the Mississippi and Ohio River basins, is now threatened by habitat loss and water quality issues.

Supporters say allowing regulated stocking could help restore the species and boost recreational fishing and tourism along Pennsylvania’s waterways.

The resolution also directs copies to key state officials and legislative committees for review.

Oct. 27, 2026: Referred to Game & Fisheries.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.palegis.us/legislation/bills/2025/sr409
